w: Sector North Carolina, Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ)
d:
General/Miscellaneous

From: 2026-10-06 To: 2026-10-27

Beginning 6 October until 23 October, the survey vessel Mobile Viking will be conducting a deep-water multibeam echo sounder (MBES) bathymetric survey offshore beginning at the EEZ, extending out to the 1000 meter contour off New Jersey, Delaware, Virginia and North Carolina). Operations comprise of hull-mounted multibeam bathymetry only. No geotechnical sampling, ROV, or AUV work will be conducted. These operations will be conducted 24 hours, 7 days a week. The survey vessel Mobile Viking will be restricted in ability to maneuver while on survey lines, request mariners transiting in the area to remain at least 2 nautical miles from their operation. Survey vessel Mobile Viking will be monitoring VHF-FM Channels 13 and 16. MSI #54983.

From: 2026-06-01 To: 2026-11-30

The Captain of the Port (COTP) North Carolina has set Port Condition Seasonal Alert in preparation for the 2026 hurricane season. Port conditions will be set in the event of forecasted severe weather in accordance with 33 CFR § 165.562.

Operators of self-propelled oceangoing vessels over 500 gross tons (GT), oceangoing tank barges and their supporting tugs, and tank barges over 200 GT must notify Sector North Carolina of any issues preventing or limiting hurricane preparedness and/or their ability to safely depart port as may be directed by the COTP that cannot be mitigated within 72 hours.

DISTRICT 5 - CGD-E MSI/General/Marine Events/Other

From: 2026-06-03 To: 2026-11-30

MARINE EVENT PERMIT APPLICATION PROCESS MODERNIZATION

The U.S. Coast Guard Navigation Center has launched a new online Marine Event Permit application process effective June 3rd. Marine event sponsors conducting regattas, marine parades, fireworks displays, swim events, or similar activities on navigable waters of the United States are encouraged to utilize the updated online submission capability. Applications should be submitted to the appropriate Captain of the Port at least 135 days prior to the scheduled event.  Marine Event Permit Application and additional information are available at: 

https://navcen.uscg.gov/contact/Application-For-Marine-Event-Permit
